evidence_gaps: Per-container Docker stats were inconsistent with target cgroup totals and are excluded from reliable conclusions.
Migration work was observed within the startup/readiness window but the initial sampler did not isolate a migration-only time series.
Load-average projection is unavailable across the non-equivalent host environments.
VPS baseline did not establish a representative production peak.
Docker storage is aggregate and does not prove per-volume quota or growth behavior.
limitations: The disposable target was a 4-vCPU, 15-GiB container running rootless Docker-in-Docker on a 12-vCPU host, not the VPS host/kernel/CPU/storage stack.
The capacity FAIL applies to the measured disposable profile; it is not a definitive verdict on VPS A+B capacity.
No VPS was accessed during F5C-3; no live financial data, dumps, backups, or secrets were used.
